reviewed: Exact fixed CID/GPT/p11 extent/UUID and all kernel partitions, both full262144byte metadata copies and CRC/header/COMMITTED2/VALID1,2/canonicalSEQ, complete pinned stock p5/p6 hashes.
Private mount namespace only, shared identity flock, all-process p11 mounts/holders/swap exclusion, mandatory existing filesystems health; read/readdir errors reject.
Own private p11 mount allowed only once at exact own path; all other observed namespaces must not expose p11.
Exact generation and token root permissions, regular inode/same filesystem, absent prior/leftover token.
Stage temp fsync, fresh metadata recheck, renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE, directory fsync and exact published readback.
Failure before publication deletes only same temporary inode; published token is retained on post-publication failure. No metadata/GPT/firmware mutation, no arm/reboot/slot selection.
resolved_findings: Directory iteration errors now explicitly reject in allproc/holders/kernel partition scans; only disappearing PID ENOENT permitted.
Builder rejects optimized Python before output directory creation, preserving asserted fixed-policy verification.
owner_test_scope: 36 synthetic token/parser cases and17 synthetic shared-view cases. Review does not count these as physical device execution.
limitations: Private ext4 mount can update journal/metadata; no other payload file should be changed by token transaction.
Snapshot scans and advisory lock do not exclude unrelated raw writers or future mounts; caller must provide exclusive maintenance.
Actual stock-kernel private mount, physical writes/durability and boot acceptance remain untested.
